title: Add bound live conversation and restricted pilot
summary: Use a unified glass frame, darker work surfaces and compact composer controls.

sections.title: What this ship changes for you
items: Use a unified glass frame, darker work surfaces and compact composer controls.
See worker status in the composer disclosure and the workers recorded for each chat in its hover card.
Recover unsent drafts, queued sends, image previews and exact retries after interruptions; matching late acknowledgements clear stale delivery warnings.
Keep the original message in the composer when saved session storage is unavailable.
Preserve work during account recovery, retain stopped terminal sessions and replies, and recover hidden or unavailable terminal panes.
Live voice remains a restricted installed pilot with a signed, expiring grant. General voice access stays disabled.
Pilot voice follows the current chat and CLI with normal transcript bubbles and stable reading position; uncertain execution or provider closure stays unconfirmed.
Installed voice conversation and live image interpretation still require acceptance testing. The saved checklist separates source checks from microphone, speaker and conversation quality.
